title: 第十五章救助叶夕瑶夫人神助攻第十六章聚灵阵万魂宗的阴谋
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 【噬心散：该毒素会侵蚀经脉丹田以及四肢百骸，最多半个时辰的时间便可侵蚀心脉，摧毁体内所有修行根基，使其变成无力的废人。】
【注意：此毒并非无药可救，需服用地阶下品丹药‘清心丹’便可恢复如初。】
噗！
李长寿看着真实之眼的介绍，一个踉跄险些摔倒，一口老血差点喷出来。
好在楚玉璃眼疾手快，扶住了他。
“夫君，可有办法？”苏千凡担忧地问道。
“需要地阶下品丹药‘清心丹’，按照我现在的状态真是无能为力。”李长寿叹息一声，表示无奈。
要是能救的话，他也很想救下她。
说不定对方还会以身相许，再不济叶家上下也会感激，送上几箱天材地宝的话，那可就起飞了。
“老爷子，真是给你添麻烦了。”
“看来本小姐命该如此，无法成为女帝了。”
就在这时，叶夕瑶轻咳出一滩黑血，满是绝望看向这片世界。
万魂宗的动作还未停止，她作为正派天之骄女。
就这样死去，她不甘啊！
“唉...天命难违，老朽会为你安排后事的。”
“你可还有什么遗愿，或者想说的？有机会我会带去你的家族。”
“当然，你的乾坤戒就当做是是报酬了。”
叶夕瑶并没有质疑李长寿的建议，反正死了都带不走，能留下遗言倒也不错。
“那好，告诉我的父亲...”
“夕瑶偷偷跑出来没有后悔，外面的世界真的很有趣也非常残酷。”
“皇城的日子太过无趣，要是再来一次，我或许还会出来看看这片世界。”
留下这句话，叶夕瑶满含热泪地闭上眼睛，等待着死亡的到来。
“夫君，曾经不是说过你是双修体质吗？”
“不仅能够增强双方修为，还能够治疗伤势，要不你试试？”
苏千凡一拍大腿，突然想到了这一点，她是真的不忍心这样的英雄死在这里。
李长寿也后知后觉地想起来了，这些天他的神经太过紧绷，居然连自己的功法都忘了。
“双修体质，这就是老爷子的体质吗？”叶夕瑶的眼睛多出一抹求生的光芒。
难怪那个叫楚玉璃的女人修为提升得这么快，上次来的时候分明也才练气，这就筑基后期了。
这老头真的隐藏得好深，或许这就是她能够活下去的唯一希望。
“说的没错，只要和我双修，你的实力会得到飞速提升，就连身上的伤势也可以恢复。”
“只不过老朽不愿趁人之危，姑娘可得想好了。”
李长寿背过身，露出一副正人君子的模样。
这份因果太重了，何况还有两名夫人在旁，他当然不能表现得太过。
总得争取两位夫人的同意是也。
“我……”叶夕瑶也在这一刻陷入了挣扎，要是真的做了，就证明以后是这老头的女人。
他倒是觉得没什么，可家族会放过他们吗？
楚玉璃：“夕瑶姐姐，夫君人真的很好，在我最落魄的时候，是他给了我一束光，给了我温暖……”
苏千凡：“有一句话叫做死了不如赖活着，只要活着就有希望，难道你就不想报仇吗？”
“那些邪修始终没有收手，你要是不在了，城中的百姓怎么办，你的家人也会伤心的……”
两位夫人也并没有让李长寿失望，全都用各自的方法劝说着。
content_en:
[Heart-eating Powder: This toxin will corrode the meridians, Dantian, and limbs. It can corrode the heart meridians in up to half an hour, destroy all the foundations of cultivation in the body, and turn it into a powerless useless person. 】
[Note: This poison is not incurable. You need to take the low-grade elixir ‘Qingxin Dan’ to recover as before. 】
Poof!
Li Changshou looked at the introduction of the Eye of Truth, staggered and almost fell, and almost spit out a mouthful of old blood.
Fortunately, Chu Yuli had quick eyes and quick hands to support him.
"Husband, is there any way?" Su Qianfan asked worriedly.
"I need the lower-grade elixir 'Qingxin Dan', but I can't do anything in my current state." Li Changshou sighed, expressing his helplessness.
He also wanted to save her if he could.
Maybe the other party will still agree to it, and no matter how bad it is, the whole Ye family will be grateful. If they send a few boxes of heavenly materials and earthly treasures, it will take off.
"Ahem..."
"Old man, I really caused trouble for you."
"It seems that this young lady is destined to be like this and will not be able to become an empress."
At this moment, Ye Xiyao coughed up a pool of black blood and looked at the world with despair.
The Wanhun Sect's actions have not stopped yet, she is the proud daughter of the upright heaven.
She was unwilling to die like this!
"Sigh... It's destiny to go against it. I will arrange your funeral arrangements for you."
"Do you have any last wishes or anything you want to say? If I have the chance, I will take you to your family."
"Of course, your Qiankun Ring will be considered as reward."
Ye Xiyao did not question Li Changshou's suggestion. He couldn't take him with him after he died anyway, so it would be nice to leave a last word.
"Well, tell my father..."
"Xiyao has no regrets when she sneaks out. The outside world is really interesting and cruel."
"The days in the Imperial City are too boring. If I could do it again, I might come out and see this world."
Leaving these words behind, Ye Xiyao closed her eyes with tears in her eyes, waiting for death to come.
"Husband, didn't you once say that you have a dual constitution?"
"Not only can it enhance the cultivation of both parties, but it can also heal injuries. Why don't you try it?"
Su Qianfan slapped her thigh and suddenly thought of this. She really couldn't bear for such a hero to die here.
Li Changshou also remembered belatedly. His nerves were so tense these days that he even forgot his own skills.
"Double cultivation of physique, is this the old man's physique?" Ye Xiyao's eyes had a gleam of survival.
No wonder the woman named Chu Yuli's cultivation improved so quickly. She was only practicing Qi when she came last time, and she was in the late stage of foundation building.
This old man really hides it so deeply. Maybe this is her only hope to survive.
"That's right. As long as you practice double cultivation with me, your strength will be rapidly improved, and even your injuries can be recovered."
"It's just that I don't want to take advantage of others, so the girl has to think about it."
Li Changshou turned his back, showing the appearance of a gentleman.
This cause and effect was too heavy, not to mention there were two ladies around, so of course he couldn't overdo it.
You have to get the consent of the two ladies.
"I..." Ye Xiyao was also struggling at this moment. If she really did it, it would prove that she was this old man's woman in the future.
He thought it was nothing, but would the family let them go?
Chu Yuli: "Sister Xiyao, my husband is really kind. When I was at my lowest, he gave me a beam of light and warmth..."
Su Qianfan: "There is a saying that it is better to live than to die. As long as you live, there is hope. Don't you want to take revenge?"
"Those evil cultivators have never stopped. If you are gone, what will happen to the people in the city? Your family will also be sad..."
The two ladies did not disappoint Li Changshou, and they all used their own methods to persuade him.
title_en: Chapter 15: Rescue Madam Ye Xiyao’s Divine Assistance Chapter 16: The Conspiracy of the Soul Gathering Array and the Ten Thousand Souls Sect
